root_cause: The custom entity class named 'Column' conflicted with JPA's @Column annotation, causing 26 compilation errors across multiple entity classes (Column.java, Task.java, User.java, BoardColumn.java). The compiler could not distinguish between the entity class and the annotation.
solution_applied: Renamed all references from the Column entity class to BoardColumn entity class (which already existed in the codebase). Updated 6 files to use BoardColumn instead of Column, eliminating the naming conflict with JPA's @Column annotation.
verification_status: Fixes applied and committed. Build verification pending.
